## Change / 变更

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and affected code or data.
说明问题、修改后的行为以及涉及的代码或数据。

## Verification / 验证

Record commands and actual results. Mark missing environments as unverified.
记录执行的命令和实际结果；缺少环境的项目请标注“未验证”。

- [ ] Public checks pass / 公开检查通过
- [ ] English and Chinese UI remain faithful and readable / 中英文界面符合信达雅要求
- [ ] Data changes include authoring inputs, deterministic outputs and lineage / 数据变更包含作者输入、确定性产物和来源记录
- [ ] Source snapshots and historical evidence retain their identities / 来源快照和历史证据身份得到保留

For data changes, describe the source, redistribution permission, and whether this is
an upstream snapshot update or a local correction. Do not include private reports,
licensed manuals, customer decks, or local machine paths.
数据变更请说明来源、再分发许可，以及属于上游快照更新还是本地修正。
不要提交私密报告、受许可约束的手册、客户模型或本机路径。
